We are foster -based, nonprofit animal rescue in Austin Texas.  Our  mission is to save animals who are at risk of being killed, whether they have been abandoned on a roadside with trucks zooming by or are facing euthanasia at a kill shelter. We are also passionate about reducing the over pet population by working to educate the public on the importance of spay/neuter, tagging and microchipping, and not supporting breeders [adopt don't shop!]


If you are interested in supporting our mission, here are some ways  you can help:   

Donations accepted via PayPal: 
http://nhanimalrescue.org/donation/
Want to foster with us? 
http://nhanimalrescue.org/foster-information/
Ready to adopt? 
http://nhanimalrescue.org/foster-information/
Want to inquire about other volunteer opportunities? 
Email NHgivelife@gmail.com
